title: Southern Copper Corporation Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: The filing reports first-half earnings, cash flow, production, realized-price exposure, capital investment, cash, debt, shares and project risks through June 30, 2026.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q is current primary evidence for Southern Copper's financial position, production, realized prices, cash costs, debt, dilution, project program and legal and jurisdictional risks.
